Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Abstract Geometric Throw Pillow, 20" x 20", Ivory
Colors: Ivory
A global-inspired abstract pattern has pops of yellow, blue, green, and red, while soft chenille yarns add a warm coziness. For a different look, it reverses to a solid ivory side. This pillow will freshen up a modern or transitional bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
